coverage: Two public synonymous SNVs: LMNA c.1824C>T and CFTR c.915C>T; native GRCh38 matching and exact versioned MANE pairs only. Absence means not covered, not experimentally normal. Not a comprehensive RNA database.
updateMethod: Repository-maintained read-only releases. Verify primary observations and allele/transcript mappings, increment record/catalog versions, recompute hashes and run focused validation. No live scraping, user JSON or silent background catalog update.

reportedAllele.description: G608G (GGC>GGT); current native GRCh38 identity established separately

transcriptMapping.alleleMappingEvidence: Paper G608G/GGC>GGT; NCBI ClinVar VCV000014500.31 HGVS identity only: NC_000001.11:g.156138613C>T = NM_170707.4:c.1824C>T. Exact MANE 1.5 pair; Ensembl version 9 exon ENSE00003606184, GRCh38 156138488-156138757, positive strand. No ClinVar classification used.

records.summary: HGPS samples with G608G showed an aberrant lamin A transcript lacking 150 nucleotides of exon 11.

experiment.rnaEvent: Internal exon 11 donor activation; 150 nt deletion. Current NM_170707.4 r.1819_1968del is a derived correspondence.
experiment.type: Patient-cell RNA RT-PCR and product sequencing
experiment.system: HGPS cell lines; primary fibroblasts for retained full-length mutant transcripts. Protein blots also used lymphoblastoid and fibroblast cells; these are distinct assays.
experiment.controls: Non-HGPS samples and minus-RT controls in Figure 2.
experiment.limitations: Incomplete splicing; retained full-length mutant clones do not quantify the fraction of all RNA. No DCM assay or pathogenicity inference.

records.molecularScope: Exact allele and versioned transcript correspondence, within the recorded assay limitations. No model-transcript identity or clinical causality claim.
records.diseaseScope: Original experiment: Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome. The molecular observation does not establish pathogenicity for DCM or other disease contexts.

provenance.compilationMethod: Codex-assisted primary-paper extraction and source/coordinate verification in this repository task; no human reviewer or clinical sign-off claimed.

source.locator: Tables 1/3, variant 2; Figures 2A/B and 3A; Minigene constructs and RT-PCR methods

records.summary: The c.915C>T minigene activated a cryptic acceptor, removing 71 bases from the start of CFTR exon 8.

experiment.rnaEvent: 71 nt deletion at the exon 8 5-prime end, confirmed by product sequencing; exon skipping also increased.
experiment.type: pDESTsplice minigene RT-PCR, capillary analysis and product sequencing
experiment.system: K562 cells, replicated in IB3-1 lung epithelial cells; rat insulin exon reporter containing CFTR exon and intronic flanks, not endogenous patient RNA.
experiment.controls: Sequence-verified reference and variant constructs; triplicate transfections pooled before RNA harvest.
experiment.limitations: Reporter context cannot establish in-vivo outcome or patient transcript fractions; carrier RNA unavailable. Other haplotype variants could modify splicing.

records.molecularScope: Exact allele and versioned transcript correspondence, within the recorded reporter assay limitations. No clinical causality claim.
records.diseaseScope: CFTR molecular reporter observation; no automatic cystic fibrosis or other disease pathogenicity assertion.
